ctaHeading: West Footscray's auto electricians are here to help.
aboutText: West Footscray Automotive has been keeping vehicles running across Melbourne's western suburbs for over 15 years from our Molesworth Court workshop. Our qualified auto electricians specialise in diagnosing and repairing all electrical faults on cars, utes, vans and commercial vehicles. From battery failures to complex wiring issues, we deliver fast, accurate repairs at fair prices. Drop in or call us — we are open Monday to Friday, 8 am to 5 pm.
servicesText: Our West Footscray workshop handles all auto electrical needs — from quick battery swaps to full rewiring jobs. We service all vehicle makes and models including European, Japanese and Australian vehicles.

services.title: Auto Electrical Diagnostics
services.desc: We use advanced scan tools and hands-on expertise to quickly pinpoint electrical faults in any vehicle make or model.

services.title: Battery Testing & Replacement
services.desc: We test, supply and fit quality batteries for cars, utes and commercial vehicles, with same-day turnaround in most cases.

services.title: Starter Motor & Alternator Repair
services.desc: Faulty starting or charging? We rebuild and replace starter motors and alternators to get you back on the road fast.

services.title: Lights, Wiring & Fuse Faults
services.desc: From blown headlights to intermittent wiring gremlins, we trace and repair all lighting and wiring issues on any vehicle.

services.title: Car Audio & Accessory Installation
services.desc: Upgrade your sound system, fit dashcams, UHF radios or tow bars — we install accessories cleanly and professionally.

services.title: Dual Battery & Solar Setups
services.desc: We design and install dual battery systems and solar panels for 4WDs, campers and tradies who need reliable power on the go.

reviews.text: Took my HiLux in when it wouldn't start — the West Footscray Automotive team found a faulty alternator within the hour and had it replaced same day. Honest pricing and friendly service, couldn't ask for more.
reviews.name: Dave Mitchell

reviews.text: We send all our fleet vehicles to West Footscray Automotive for electrical servicing. They handle our battery replacements and diagnostic work efficiently every time. Reliable auto electricians who know their stuff.
reviews.name: Karen O'Brien

reviews.text: Had a tricky wiring fault causing my headlights to flicker on my Ranger. The team at West Footscray traced it quickly and fixed it properly. Really glad I found a proper auto electrician so close to home.
reviews.name: Steve Nguyen
